introduction: Explore the Caverns of the Worms and bring exact skins and hides to Wilms for equipment. His sixteen independent commissions are supporting crafting services. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter from the Underdark and follow the short duergar corridor to the old tool alcove. Wilms is the curer who offers equipment for worm skins and hides. ASK wilms about cure, hide or wormskin, then use the listed equipment topics to hear his recipes. Recognized dialogue reveals the contact; each keyword is not a separate achievement.

The burrows contain grey, glowing, brown, red and purple worms. Small worms supply strips, middle-sized worms supply pieces and large worms supply whole hides. These exact colors and sizes are different materials; a hide cannot stand in for several strips or pieces. Exploration has several overlapping routes rather than a required personal quest order.

Choose the equipment you want and gather its complete bundle loose in inventory. Repeated ingredients require separate items together. The shield needs five items, the armor needs three separate red strips and two hides, and the mask, cloak and gloves need matching pairs. The journal shows current quantities; spent, nested, held or worn materials are not ready now.

ASK describes a recipe but does not select an order. If several complete bundles share an offered material, Wilms accepts the first matching complete request. Extra materials can make a larger or different commission take precedence. Keep only the intended complete bundle available when practical, and inspect the received equipment. A journal card does not reserve materials or select the native hand-in.

Some materials serve several commissions. Grey strip and red hide can make a helmet or contribute to a backpack; glowing strip can make an ear clasp or combine with purple strip for a ring. The shield overlaps the boots ingredients. Choose how to spend your stock; receiving equipment is separate from having materials ready for another commission.

A small fixed pile of garbage conceals a blocked passage in the red burrows. PUSH the garbage to affect the south passage toward the purple worm route. A passage another player already opened is usable without your own earlier solve. The garbage stays fixed and is separate from Wilms's ingredient requests.

Bring light for the dark burrows and respect normal movement, combat and access rules. Wet descriptions do not by themselves require swimming or flight. The Underdark entrance is south from the entry cavern despite its old description; the deeper connector route is separate. An incoming veil can also arrive here, but using it is not a required step.

Exact supplied skins and hides fit without your own earlier kills, source recovery, tunnel visits, dialogue or control history. Accepting a commission records its independent service receipt; owning its reward alone does not prove acceptance. These services do not add quest achievements or dailies. Discovery remains a separate achievement, and new credit requires active, ready accounting.

contacts.name: Wilms
contacts.description: Wilms starts in the old tool alcove. Ask about his curing trade or an equipment piece to learn its exact recipe. Asking does not select an order; competing complete bundles can affect the hand-in.

stories.title: Wilms: helmet
stories.summary: Bring 1 × a strip of grey wormskin; 1 × a red wormhide together for a wormskin helmet. This is an independent equipment-making service. Keep competing complete bundles in mind when offering a material.
